question: If triangles ABC and PQR are both isosceles with AB = AC and PQ = PR, respectively. If also AB = PQ and BC = QR and angle B = 50°, then what is the measure of angle R?
solution:
**Given:**

 ABC and PQR are isosceles triangles, AB = AC, PQ = PR and

AB = PQ and BC = QR and ∠B = 50° 

**Concept used:**

Congruency criterion of triangles

**Calculation:**

It is given that AB = AC and PQ = PR but AB = PQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8cffc632899e53df6fad021edf1ed574e39ee26fb49cefd177f5b1b8c0157c1.png] 

⇒ AB = AC = PQ = PR -------(1)

In triangle ABC and triangle PQR

AB = PQ (By equation-1)

BC = QR (Given)

AC = PR (By equation-1)

Now, By **SSS (side-side-side) congruency **criterion

⇒ triangle ABC cong triangle PQR

Then, By Corresponding parts of congruent triangles-

⇒ ∠ ABC=∠ PQR= 50circ

Since, triangle PQR is an isosceles triangle

⇒ ∠ PQR=∠ PRQ

⇒ ∠ PRQ=50circ

**.·. The measure of angle R is 50°.**
